item.title: Verifiable Agentic Traffic Class: A Policed Quality-of-Service Mechanism for Agentic AI Traffic, Evaluated from Simulation to Real-Kernel Adversarial Testing
item.description: Software agents built on large language models generate traffic unlike human web traffic, yet routers have no class for it and cannot verify a sender's claim to be an agent. VATC was compared with static Differentiated Services (DiffServ), a dedicated class that trusts the marking, — 来源：verge_ai · techcrunch_ai · arxiv — 原文：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14211v1

item.title: Optimization-Based Path Planning for Industrial Manipulators: Experimental Validation in Additive Manufacturing
item.description: Robotic additive manufacturing requires joint paths that reconcile robot feasibility with process-specific geometry. Full-path and boundary-coupled chunked optimization handle references of different lengths. Iterative Weight Tuning (IWT) determines the cost weights from the gaps between Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and their targets.
